body:
Independent follow-up to the preserved W06 review `20261108T071757Z-w06-ten-unions-independent-metadata-v2` (authoritative YAML SHA256 `01a7f358f637ce22e8db311ca290c92e010fad757120f1ae43e89265b1742e32`). I verified all 670 manifest-listed proof files and independently matched the ten reviewed payloads to the active 37-candidate set. These are unapplied candidates, not owner or release approvals. Original reviews, source captures and histories remain immutable.

**W06-TU-001 — stale PIPES compatibility pointer.** The current reconciled `Pipes.yaml` candidate is SHA256 `b8391d5119461e7a009abd939df195b521b04e65df267e461532f0e6b70105dc`. Its exact source-supported free-acid identity and ontology target are CHEBI:44933, but `kg_microbe_node_id` still asserts CHEBI:39033. The unmodified native compatibility checker passes all ten authentic beforeimages and fails both the ten reviewed candidates and the full active 37 solely on this same-prefix mismatch. This is an execution blocker for these bytes, independently reproduced before any application.

Preserve the source-supported acid correction. [MediaDive867](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/867) supplies CAS5625-37-6, C8H18N2O6S2 and mass302.37; its [medium964](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/964) weighs6.05g. [ChEBI44933](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/CHEBI:44933) and [PubChem79723](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/79723) agree on the acid formula/InChI. The separate TOGO M1052 spelling PIPES(Sigma) is a weighed reagent; no historical catalogue number is inferred. These facts do not identify a prepared PIPES_Buffer or unspecified final10mM occurrence.

Withdraw the obsolete exact compatibility pointer, or replace it only if the actual downstream KG node is verified; an ontology term's existence does not prove a KG node exists. Append truthful history and independently review the corrected whole candidate. A direct native row projection of the current candidate emits `MIM:Pipes → CHEBI:44933 skos:exactMatch`, confidence0.9 and ManualMappingCuration under CAS_RN_LOOKUP. Its identity override is correct; no grade/predicate gate or threshold change is needed. SSSOM justification vocabulary is separate from the human-only MappingEvidence enum tracked in #1226.

An ignored-inclusive scan of all2,956 direct baseline YAML owners and all37 current candidate payloads found no component_id references to CHEBI:39033 or44933. This is a bounded component-reference check, not a claim that external mappings/semantic claims need no regeneration. Preserve #718's source/preparation holds and all content-bound approval withdrawals; future canonical/native receipts and current-source review remain required. Proof: `C/preflight/ten-unions-findings-triage-v1/{native-reproduction,pipes-dependency-inventory,primary-bindings}.json`.
